If `plain` contains `A\nB`, and it is split into segments, say `A` and `B`, joining them with `\n` will result in `A\nB\n`, which is incorrect if the original text was `A\nB`.

If the original text is `A\nB`, and it is processed by `escape(plain[position:offset])`, the segment `A\n` will be escaped. If the segment is `A`, and the next is `B`, and they are joined by `\n`, we get `A\nB`.
